meta.name: Kafé Bangkok café data
meta.note: Compiled from public 2026 café guides (see each café's sources). Descriptions are original summaries. Hours and prices change: check each café before marking verified:true.
meta.locations: lat/lng checked 9 November 2026 from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL) and Wongnai listings; cafés inside a mall or hotel use the building. null = no reliable location found (cafés without one were removed on 9 November 2026). Station positions (meta.stations) from OpenStreetMap, 9 November 2026. Cafés added from new-cafes.json use their Wongnai listing pin or, where Wongnai had none (or an old address), their Time Out Bangkok venue pin.

cafes.name: Ssoundnamm

cafes.name: riri cafe

cafes.name: Luka Cafe
